title: Marvel Has Assigned 42 Hours of Homework Before ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
summary: The studio released an official catch-up list ahead of December’s release. We have easy links to watch every one of the movies so you can get up to speed.
llm_summary: Marvel has put together a “homework” guide that lists every MCU film you need to watch before the upcoming December release of *Avengers: Doomsday*. The studio’s official catch‑up list includes easy links to each movie, making it simple for fans (and newcomers) to get up to speed in roughly 42 hours of viewing.
